amicable_count.prompt: Print how many integers n with 2 <= n <= 2000 are amicable (the sum of the proper divisors of n equals some m != n whose proper-divisor sum is n).

resultant.prompt: Print the resultant of the polynomials x^4 - 1 and x^3 + 2*x + 1 over Q.

factors_x15.prompt: Print the number of irreducible factors of x^15 - 1 over the rationals.

mult_order.prompt: Print the multiplicative order of 2 modulo the prime 1000000007.

bernoulli_digits.prompt: Print the number of decimal digits of the numerator of the Bernoulli number B_10000 (use the absolute value of the numerator).

splitting_degree.prompt: Print the degree over Q of the splitting field of x^3 - 2.

galois_order.prompt: Print the order of the Galois group of the polynomial x^5 - 2 over Q.

torsion_units.prompt: Print the number of roots of unity in the number field Q[x]/(x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + x + 1).

s4_normal.prompt: Print the number of normal subgroups of the symmetric group S_4 (including the trivial subgroup and the whole group).

sylow2_s8.prompt: Print the order of a Sylow 2-subgroup of the symmetric group S_8.

aut_d12.prompt: Print the order of the automorphism group of the dihedral group of order 12.

matrix_order_ff.prompt: Print the multiplicative order of the matrix [[1,1],[0,1]] in GL(2, GF(5)).

smith_largest.prompt: Print the largest elementary divisor (last diagonal entry of the Smith normal form) of the integer matrix [[2,4,4],[-6,6,12],[10,-4,-16]].

petersen_chromatic.prompt: Print the chromatic number of the Petersen graph.

petersen_auto.prompt: Print the order of the automorphism group of the Petersen graph.

e8_aut_order.prompt: Print the order of the automorphism group of the E8 root lattice.

e8_kissing.prompt: Print the kissing number (number of minimal vectors) of the E8 root lattice.

hamming_mindist.prompt: Print the minimum distance of the binary [7,4] Hamming code.

golay_mindist.prompt: Print the minimum distance of the binary [23,12,7] Golay code.

variety_size.prompt: Print the number of solutions over the algebraic closure of Q of the system x + y + z = 0, x*y + y*z + z*x = 0, x*y*z = 1.
